description: Geotechnical Engineering and Geo-Sciences Response to the February 6, 2023 Turkiye Earthquake Sequence is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Jonathan Stewart, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). As a follow-on to the GEER Association reconnaissance activities, targeted site investigations were performed at specific locations in the regions affected by the two large earthquakes in Türkiye on February 6, 2023. These events caused devastating structural collapses, infrastructure damage, widespread liquefaction, and surface fault rupture. Coverage: Pazarcik, Kahramanmaras, Turkiye, Elbistan, Kahramanmaras, Turkiye. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: 2023 Turkiye Earthquakes, Site investigations, Liquefaction, Strong Ground Motion Station Soil Profile. Published 2025-06-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
